definitions.explanation: The tendency to see the worst aspect of things or believe that the worst will happen. Also used as a philosophical term for the doctrine that the world is fundamentally bad or that evil outweighs good.

examples.japanese: {悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。
examples.english: His pessimism affects those around him too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過度|かど}→過度：14377_kado⟧な{悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げる→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Excessive pessimism can hinder the resolution of problems.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧ (pessimism, taking a gloomy view) and ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (principle, -ism). Refers both to the everyday tendency toward negative thinking and to the philosophical doctrine of pessimism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧: to fall into pessimism
- {悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧: pessimistic thinking
- {悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{克服|こくふく}する→克服する：15863_kokufukusuru⟧: to overcome pessimism

RELATED WORDS:
- {悲観主義者|ひかんしゅぎしゃ}: pessimist (the person)
- ⟦{楽観主義|らっかんしゅぎ}→楽観主義：17711_rakkanshugi⟧: optimism — the opposite concept
- ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧: pessimism / taking a gloomy view — the base word without the -ism suffix

USAGE:
In Japanese, ⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧ alone is more commonly used in everyday speech. {悲観主義|ひかんしゅぎ} tends to appear in more formal or philosophical discussions.
